selector.rationale: Histiocytic medullary reticulosis best explains the combination of hemophagocytosis, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, and cytopenias, with the highest score and most supporting evidence

rejected.label: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
rejected.why: While hemophagocytosis is present, other findings such as lymphadenopathy and specific histiocytic features are more suggestive of Histiocytic medullary reticulosis

rejected.label: Myelodysplastic syndrome
rejected.why: Although dysplastic changes are seen in the bone marrow, the presence of hemophagocytosis and specific histiocytic features are not typical for Myelodysplastic syndrome

rejected.label: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation
rejected.why: While blasts are present, the clinical and histological features are more consistent with Histiocytic medullary reticulosis
